usage: dotnet meta gen [<metadataDir>] --out <dir> [--namespace <ns>] [--generators <a,b,c>] [--template-root <dir>] [--emit-abstract-shapes] [--baseline default|adopt]
       dotnet meta gen --list
  runs the generator list in codegen/Generators.cs (`dotnet meta init` writes it);
  --generators narrows that list to the entries named, and never adds one.
  column/table naming: "naming" in .metaobjects/config.json (ADR-0058), not a flag here
